detail.longDescription: "A new # study claims that individuals possessing higher levels of the personality trait openness are less prone to # antisemitic attitudes, and that this relationship is partially mediated by interpersonal contact with # Jewish individuals. This is based on # research -published in the August issue of # PersonalityandIndividualDifferences . # TaliaMorstead and # AnitaDeLongis from the Department of # Psychology at the # University of # BritishColumbia conducted the study. The # researchers set out to explore the # psychosocial mechanisms underlying antisemitic attitudes, noting that “#antisemitism is an enduring phenomenon with parallels to other forms of # prejudice yet demonstrates a distinctive capacity to adapt in rhetorical form to the prevailing # sociocultural context." https://www. jpost.com/diaspora/antisemitis m/article-907052
